A daily English digest of German professional basketball (easyCredit BBL),
generated by a self-hosted pipeline: multiple German sources per story,
combined into short original summaries with links to every source. Summaries
are machine-generated and validated automatically; errors are possible, the
linked originals are authoritative. Follow me on X at [@aaronmartinphd](https://x.com/aaronmartinphd).
